observation: Three individually valid open-edge socket cutters overlapped along the gauge edge and separated two narrow edge islands from the intended coupon body.
hypothesis: When adjacent boundary-opening cutters overlap, the remaining boundary segments can become disconnected islands even though every cutter and the resulting multi-solid B-Rep are individually valid.
limitations: One CadQuery/OpenCascade coupon and one trapezoid socket family were observed.
The 14 mm pitch is project geometry, not a universal socket-spacing rule.
